data.title: 蕾塞 · 清晨床沿的白衬衫
data.description: 【蕾塞 · 清晨床沿的白衬衫】清晨的破旧公寓，阳光从蒙尘的窗户斜斜照进来。蕾塞单穿一件白衬衫坐在床沿，扣子只系了两颗，晨光在她赤着的腿上勾出金色的边。她伸了个懒腰，回头冲你狡黠一笑——「……早啊。要一起吃早饭吗？还是说，你更想先吃点别的？」
data.promptProse: Adult Reze sits sideways on the bed, stretching both arms behind her with her shirt open, looking back with a mischievous smile. Warm morning light slants through the dusty window and rims her bare legs.
data.action: 单穿白衬衫坐在床沿，晨光中回头轻笑
data.lighting: warm slanting morning sunlight, dust motes in the air, soft window glow
data.animaCaption: She stretches both arms behind her and looks back from the bed edge with a playful smile.
